column3: Section  42  of  the  principal  enactment  is  hereby
repealed and the following section substituted therefor:—
42. Any party aggrieved by the decision of
an  Agrarian  Tribunal  on  any  application  or
complaint  referred  to  it  under  this  Act,  may
make  an  appeal  to  a  Board  of  Review
days from the date of receipt of such decision.”.
The following new Part is inserted immediately after
section 42 of the principal enactment and shall have effect
